=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/blocker_check.py:140 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_candidate_pr_truth` and `_candidate_issue_state` pass absent or malformed `linked_pr`/`state` values through as `None` before terminality checks.
  WHY: Unvalidated non-string or missing values from GitHub responses can trigger type errors or wrong terminality decisions, letting non-ready blockers dispatch.
- scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh:118-130 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The inline token expansion can drop `GH_TOKEN` when only that variable is set.
  WHY: The helper then runs unauthenticated, so workflow dispatches fail and stall escalation is delayed until the next cron tick.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:554 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The workflow defines `STALL_THRESHOLD_IMPLEMENTING_MINUTES` twice, with a second duplicate at line 554.
  WHY: Duplicate YAML keys can override or fail parsing, which breaks CI linting and makes stall-guard thresholds inconsistent.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1406 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The socket-count probe is used in arithmetic without verifying the output is numeric.
  WHY: A failed or empty probe can produce bash arithmetic errors or wrong zero/nonzero handling, causing the watchdog to misclassify process state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8417 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The shared actions-runs cache is mutated without locking across parallel dispatch paths.
  WHY: Concurrent updates can stale the running-state counts and allow dispatch beyond concurrency caps.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:400-420 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Status-file parsing accepts non-empty files without validating `state=` and silently falls back on parse failure.
  WHY: Partial or malformed writes can hide the real stall-guard termination path and lose the correct salvage/diagnostic handling.
- scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh:106 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The helper does a full `git clone --depth 1` on each call when the memory branch is missing or diverged.
  WHY: This adds repeated network and disk I/O on the orchestrator tick path without a cache or faster existence check.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:500 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `memory_force_tick_*` functions are added without a deprecation shim or backward-compatible fallback.
  WHY: Consumers pinned to the prior helper naming contract may not see the new functions and can break.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "archive the plan after verified completion"
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/symphony-inspired-improvements-plan.md moved/copied to docs/completed/ (or similar archival location) plus an update to the final-merge handler in orchestrate_poll_process.sh:mark_validation_complete (or equivalent in validate.yml)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk touches any plan file, no archival step or docs/completed/ directory is created, and no reference appears in the final-merge logic.
- requirement: Wire all new contract/regression tests into the explicit CI/test-and-mark-stable allowlists so they run on every PR and stable promotion.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: New tests are only partially added and most are absent from the allowlists, so regressions in the new stall-guard, renderer shim, and workspace mechanisms will not be caught by CI.
- requirement: Make the S2 event-idle kill mode default to the documented tight implement-phase threshold (90 minutes) across workflows and the poller.
  expected_change_site: Default values in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, .github/workflows/implement.yml, and orchestrate_lib.py:build_concurrency_snapshot
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Most workflows still default `CODEX_STALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` to 600s, the poller bypass for final-merge PRs is not updated to respect the new guard, and the duplicate key masks the intended default.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
